a.en: Snug tight is the condition where the bolt is tightened to a relatively low preload just to draw the joint members into firm contact — typically achieved by a few impacts from an impact wrench or 2-3 hand turns of a wrench. The purpose is to hold the joint together while all bolts are installed before final torque. Snug tight is not a measured value; it is a feel-based condition. Full torque (or 'turn-of-nut' completion) is the final specified torque applied in a controlled pattern. The 'turn-of-nut' method uses snug tight + a calculated additional rotation to achieve preload, which is often more consistent than direct torque for large bolts.
a.de: Snug tight beschreibt einen Zustand geringer Vorspannung, der die Verbindungsteile nur fest in Kontakt zieht; er wird mit wenigen Schlägen des Schlagschraubers oder zwei bis drei Handumdrehungen erreicht. Er dient dazu, den Verbund zu halten, während alle Schrauben eingebaut sind, bevor das endgültige Drehmoment aufgebracht wird. Snug tight ist kein gemessener Wert, sondern ein gefühlsbasierter Zustand. Das volle Anziehdrehmoment ist das festgelegte Endmoment, das in kontrollierter Reihenfolge aufgebracht wird; beim Verfahren 'Drehen der Mutter' kommt zu Snug tight ein berechneter zusätzlicher Drehwinkel hinzu, um die Vorspannung einzustellen. Für große Schrauben ist dieses Verfahren oft gleichmäßiger als das direkte Drehmomentanziehen. Halten Sie Anziehreihenfolge, Zwischenmomente und den erreichten Drehwinkel schriftlich fest, damit die Montage nachvollzogen werden kann, wenn eine Verbindung später geprüft werden muss.
a.fr: Le serrage au contact, ou snug tight, est l'état où le boulon est amené à une précharge relativement faible, juste pour mettre les pièces en contact ferme : on l'obtient généralement avec quelques coups de clé à choc ou 2 à 3 tours de clé à la main. Son rôle est de maintenir l'assemblage pendant que tous les boulons sont posés avant le serrage final. Le snug tight n'est pas une valeur mesurée ; c'est un état ressenti. Le couple final, ou finition par la méthode tourne-écrou, est le couple spécifié appliqué selon une séquence contrôlée. La méthode tourne-écrou part du serrage au contact puis ajoute une rotation calculée pour atteindre la précharge visée ; elle est souvent plus régulière que le couple direct sur les gros boulons, par exemple les diamètres M36 en classe 10.9. Cette séquence figure dans la spécification de l'assemblage critique, avec les valeurs en N·m et l'angle de rotation.
a.pt: O aperto de contato, ou snug tight, é a condição em que o parafuso leva a uma pré-carga relativamente baixa, apenas para colocar as peças em contato firme: obtém-se geralmente com alguns golpes de chave de impacto ou 2 a 3 voltas de chave manual. Sua função é manter a junta enquanto todos os parafusos são instalados antes do aperto final. O snug tight não é um valor medido; é uma condição por sensação. O torque final, ou conclusão pelo método de rotação da porca, é o torque especificado aplicado em sequência controlada. O método de rotação parte do aperto de contato e soma uma rotação calculada para atingir a pré-carga almejada; costuma ser mais regular que o torque direto em parafusos de grande diâmetro, por exemplo M36 na classe 10.9. Essa sequência consta na especificação da junta crítica, com os valores em N·m e o ângulo de rotação.
a.es: El aprieto al contacto, o snug tight, es la condición en que el perno llega a una precarga relativamente baja, solo para poner las piezas en contacto firme: se obtiene generalmente con unos pocos golpes de llave de impacto o 2 a 3 vueltas de llave manual. Su función es mantener la unión mientras se instalan todos los pernos antes del apriete final. El snug tight no es un valor medido; es una condición por sensación. El par final, o conclusión por el método de giro de tuerca, es el par especificado aplicado en secuencia controlada. El método de giro parte del aprieto al contacto y añade una rotación calculada para alcanzar la precarga buscada; suele ser más regular que el par directo en pernos de gran diámetro, por ejemplo M36 en clase 10.9. Esta secuencia figura en la especificación de la unión crítica, con los valores en N·m y el ángulo de rotación.
a.ar: الشد التلامسي حالة يصل فيها البرغي إلى قدرة مسبقة منخفضة نسبياً لإحكام تلامس القطع: ويُحصل عليه بعد ضربات قليلة من مطرقة الشد أو دورتين إلى ثلاث يدوية، ودوره تثبيت الوصلة أثناء تركيب كل البراغي قبل الشد النهائي. وهو ليس قيمة مقاسة بل حالة تُحس باليد. أما العزم النهائي فهو العزم المحدد المطبق بتسلسل مضبوط. وتنطلق طريقة دوران الصامولة من الشد التلامسي ثم تضيف دورانًا محسوباً للوصول إلى القدرة المسبقة المستهدفة.
a.zh: snug tight 是先用较低预紧力把接头各件拉至贴紧，通常用冲击扳手打几下或手拧 2–3 圈，目的是在所有螺栓装好前先固定接头；它不是量值而是手感状态。full torque（或 turn-of-nut 完成）是按规定的顺序与数值施加的最终扭矩。turn-of-nut 法即在 snug tight 后追加一个计算转角来达到预紧力，对大螺栓往往比直接扭矩更稳定。
a.ja: スナッグタイトは低い締付力で継手各部材を密着させる状態で、インパクトレンチで数打撃または手回し2〜3回転で得られます。全ボルト装着前に継手を保持するのが目的で、数値ではなく感覚的な状態です。フルトルク（またはターンオブナットの完了）は規定の順序・値で与える最終トルクです。ターンオブナット法はスナッグタイト後に計算した追い回転を与える方法で、大径ボルトでは直接トルク法より安定します。
a.hi: स्नग-टाइट कम प्री-लोड वाली अवस्था है, जिसमें बोल्ट से जोड़ के हिस्से सटा दिए जाते हैं; इसे रिंच के कुछ प्रहार या 2–3 घुमाव से पाया जाता है। मकसद अंतिम टॉर्क से पहले सभी बोल्ट लगने तक जोड़ जकड़ा रहता है; यह मापी गई रकम नहीं, हाथ की महसूस पर आधारित है। फुल टॉर्क नियंत्रित क्रम में लगाया गया निर्धारित अंतिम टॉर्क है। नट-घुमाव तरीका स्नग-टाइट में तय अतिरिक्त घुमाव जोड़ता है; बड़े बोल्टों पर यह सीधे टॉर्क से ज़्यादा सुसंगत रहता है।
a.ru: Snug tight — умеренная затяжка для плотного контакта деталей: достаточно нескольких ударов гайковёрта или 2–3 оборотов ключа перед финальной затяжкой всех болтов. Это не измеряемое значение, а состояние на ощупь, при котором элементы прижаты без зазора. Полный момент (full torque) — расчётный момент по контролируемой схеме: болты затягивают крест-накрест в проходы, с моментом из спецификации для класса прочности и состояния резьбы. Метод поворота гайки (turn-of-nut) добавляет к тугой затяжке расчётный угол поворота и для крупных болтов M24 и выше даёт более стабильную предварительную затяжку, чем прямой момент. Метод выбирают по проекту: для ответных фланцевых соединений фиксируют и момент, и угол, а контроль проводят по меткам на головке болта и выступающей части резьбы.

For B2B buyers operating in multiple countries, harmonize specifications with regional standards and local customs requirements. Common regional frameworks: SABS (South Africa), KEBS (Kenya), TBS (Tanzania), ZIMRA (Zimbabwe), SON (Nigeria), and AfCFTA standards for pan-Africa trade. Local standards compliance is often mandatory for public infrastructure projects, mining operations, and government tenders.

Torque is a proxy for tension, and the proxy is only as good as the friction assumption behind it. The relationship is simple in form - torque equals the product of the tension required, the nominal diameter and a friction factor - and unstable in practice, because the friction factor moves with coating, lubrication, thread condition and the hardness of the bearing surface. A joint tightened to a torque figure with an uncontrolled friction factor may be at half the intended preload, and nothing about the wrench reading reveals it.

The friction factor, usually written as K, is the number that has to be established rather than assumed. It is measured by tightening instrumented samples of the actual bolt, nut and washer combination, with the actual coating and lubrication, and recording the tension produced at the specified torque. Published tables give a range for a coating family; only a test gives the value for the lot in hand. Where the design depends on achieving a preload, the test belongs in the specification, and the certificate should state the K value and the test method.

Wrench selection follows from the tolerance required. A manual torque wrench is adequate for small volumes and for joints where the tolerance is loose; a calibrated torque wrench with a recorded calibration date is the minimum for anything inspected. For high-volume and critical work, torque multipliers, hydraulic tensioners and direct-tension indicators each solve a different problem: a multiplier reaches high torque with a controlled input, a tensioner applies load directly and avoids friction in the torque path, and a direct-tension indicator shows whether the preload was achieved rather than whether a torque was applied.

Flange joints add their own discipline. The gasket compresses progressively, so the bolts must be tightened in a cross pattern in stages, and the joint must be re-tightened after the first service cycle when the gasket has taken its set. Skipping the re-tightening is how a leak appears a month after a successful pressure test, and it is the reason flange procedures specify a sequence rather than a single torque figure.

Verification is the part buyers most often omit. The tension-calibration device measures the tension produced by a tightening method on a sample and is the reference for establishing the method; direct-tension indicators sit under the nut or head and show, by the gap they leave, whether the specified tension was reached. Both are better evidence than a wrench reading, and both are what an inspector will ask for when the connection is safety-critical.

The buyer requirements that make all of this enforceable are therefore: the K value with its test method, the tightening method and sequence, the calibration record for the equipment, the verification method, and the documentation that ties each lot to its test. Without those, torque is a number that was applied, not a preload that was achieved.

Finally, write the tightening procedure into the method statement rather than leaving it to the crew: the pattern, the stages, the verification sample and the record form. A procedure that exists only in conversation is not repeatable, and preload that cannot be repeated cannot be inspected.

Keep the record form with the joint tag number: one sheet per flange or per connection group, filed with the pressure test so the two can be read together.

File it before the second cycle, not after the leak.
